$CELWEIGHT.evidence: Autodesk documents -3 as DEFAULT, -2 as BYBLOCK, -1 as BYLAYER and the listed fixed lineweights in hundredths of a millimeter. ObjectARX marks -4 ByDIPs as internal use only; it is not admitted.

$XEDIT.evidence: 0 disables and 1 enables in-place editing of a referenced drawing.

implementation.dxfOutput: Validate canonical dollar/bare aliases, integer type, exact group code, and each documented field domain before writing the HEADER. Refuse invalid values atomically; parsing remains tolerant.
implementation.lineweightScope: CELWEIGHT uses Autodesk's enumerated fixed lineweight values rather than accepting every integer from 0 through 211.
implementation.semanticLimit: Scalar admission only. This does not qualify lineweight rendering, plotting, or native application behavior.

coverage: ASCII/Binary output and typed readback for every enumerated CELWEIGHT value and all ENDCAPS, JOINSTYLE, LWDISPLAY, and XEDIT values.
Out-of-domain values, wrong group codes, wrong variant types, and duplicate dollar/bare aliases are refused atomically.
A failed write is followed by a corrected value through the same writer for each field and both encodings.
Tolerant ASCII input preserves an unsupported integer value for each of CELWEIGHT, ENDCAPS, JOINSTYLE, LWDISPLAY, and XEDIT.
